observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 9.
The box is placed on top of several other brown cardboard shipping cartons.
The box features a large image of a circular black speaker.
Text on the box identifies it as a 'PORTABLE STEREO BLUETOOTH HOME SPEAKER'.
There is a watermark 'HOME OF ASSORTED LEGIT' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' across the center.
The actual speaker unit is not visible; only the packaging is shown.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different object.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual speaker outside of the box.

risks.risk: The item may be a counterfeit or high-quality clone.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the serial number plate and the charging ports on the device.

risks.risk: The speaker may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the device powering on, pairing, and playing music.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual speaker unit outside of the box.
Photo of the serial number and regulatory markings on the bottom or back of the speaker.
Video of the speaker powered on and playing audio to verify functionality.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is shown. Without photos of the actual device, its existence, condition, and authenticity cannot be verified for a safe valuation.
